beats.summary: Michael decides to use the surplus money to buy a new copier, leading to disagreement among staff.

evidence.snippet: Andy: We're getting married at Schrute Farms, no matter what.

beats.summary: Jim makes a joke about making his own copies because Pam's copier sucks.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Ever since Pam and I started dating, I just feel weird asking her to make copies for me. So, I make my own copies. And that copier sucks.
